en.title: Rome I, Maltese version: Article 8(4) refers to paragraph 2 or 2a, and there is no paragraph 2a
en.summary: The other versions of the escape clause for employment contracts refer to paragraphs 2 or 3. Article 8 has no paragraph 2a.
en.impact: In the Maltese text the comparison with a more closely connected country leaves out the country of paragraph 3 (the place of business that engaged the employee) and names a paragraph that does not exist.

mt.title: Ruma I, verżjoni Maltija: l-Artikolu 8(4) jirreferi għall-paragrafu 2 jew 2a, u m'hemmx paragrafu 2a
mt.summary: Il-verżjonijiet l-oħra tal-klawżola liberatorja għall-kuntratti ta' impjieg jirreferu għall-paragrafi 2 jew 3. L-Artikolu 8 m'għandux paragrafu 2a.
mt.impact: Fit-test Malti, it-tqabbil ma' pajjiż li miegħu l-kuntratt ikun aktar marbut iħalli barra l-pajjiż indikat fil-paragrafu 3 (fejn ikun jinsab in-negozju li fih ġie impjegat l-impjegat) u jsemmi paragrafu li ma jeżistix.
